_comment: Your search preferences and constraints. Hard constraints exclude a listing outright in the ranker; soft preferences only change its score. Leave a field null/empty to leave it unconstrained. This file is private (gitignored once copied to preferences.json).
_commute_note: For each target with an address, the ranker geocodes it (Census geocoder) and shows an OSRM driving estimate per listing: road-network time with no live traffic. max_minutes only flags the estimate when set; it never excludes.
_deal_breakers_note: Keywords that exclude a listing outright when present in its text, e.g. ['no pets', '55+', 'income 3x rent', 'no parking']. If you have pets, add 'no pets' here too.
_must_have_note: Keywords matched against the listing text, e.g. ['in-unit laundry', 'parking', 'dishwasher', 'ac']. When must_have_strict is true, a listing missing one is excluded; otherwise it just loses points.
_nice_to_have_note: Keywords that add score when present, e.g. ['yard', 'garage', 'second bathroom', 'near caltrain'].

budget._note: max_rent is a HARD constraint (monthly listed rent). Set target_rent to what you'd happily pay; listings under it score higher.

layout._note: min_* are HARD constraints when set. property_types examples: Apartment, Single Family, Condo, Townhouse, Duplex, Multi Family. Empty = any.

move_in._note: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Mostly used by you/ranker notes today; listing feeds rarely publish availability dates reliably.

location_quality._note: min_walk_score is a HARD constraint when set and the listing has been enriched with a Walk Score (apartmentfinder.py enrich). Unknown scores never exclude.
